question: The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2022 was passed in Rajya Sabha in December 2022. It seeks to amend the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950, with respect to its application to the State of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Karnataka**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2022 aims to amend the **Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950**.
 
• The amendment specifically pertains to its application to the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• The bill was passed in the **Rajya Sabha** in December 2022.
 
• The amendment aims to include certain communities in the list of **Scheduled Tribes** in Karnataka.
 
• This move is intended to provide these communities with the benefits and protections accorded to Scheduled Tribes under the **Indian Constitution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Scheduled Tribes in India** are specific indigenous communities that are recognized by the Indian Constitution. They are provided with certain benefits and protections to promote social and economic development. These communities are identified in the **Scheduled Tribes list** which is periodically updated by the government.

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Scheduled Tribes
 Indigenous communities recognized by the Indian Constitution for special benefits.
 
 

 Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950
 An order that lists the recognized Scheduled Tribes across various states in India.
 
 

 Rajya Sabha
 The upper house of India's Parliament where the bill was passed.
 
 

 Amendment Bill
 A formal change or addition proposed during the process of legislation.
 
 

 Karnataka
 A state in India to which the amendment bill pertains.
